title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron home
summary:
The Israeli military has launched a sweeping crackdown in the occupied West Bank, demolishing homes and businesses in the city of Hebron and displacing hundreds of families, according to local officials.
Footage shared online showed destruction caused by Israeli bulldozers, with at least one whole street appearing to have been flattened.
The operation was announced by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Friday, in response to the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen in an attack on a checkpoint.
Three other Israeli soldiers were injured, and the gunmen were also killed.
The city's governor and deputy mayor meanwhile said at least 200 families had been displaced.
